contract.behavioralQuestion: Can one bounded second-addition admission experiment isolate exact same-occurrence joint evidence?
contract.singleHypothesis: For one otherwise legacy-valid proposal that would change the added set from cardinality 1 to 2, require an exact ReducedOnly same-occurrence joint witness; otherwise abstain without reroll.
contract.eligibilityRule: Hard validity passed; exactly one previously accepted pass-1 completion member exists at the timestamp; the already-selected legacy proposal would make the exact added CompletionSet cardinality two.
contract.hardInvalidHandling: Existing geometry and format validity run first. Hard-invalid proposals are excluded from D1EligibleDecisions and are never D1 abstentions.
contract.noRerollRule: One legacy proposal produces one disposition. Abstention advances to the next pre-existing opportunity with no lane, shape, candidate, chance, or RNG retry caused by D1.
contract.originalEvidenceRule: The immutable index is built only from OriginalObjects. Synthetic objects may never become donors, witnesses, frequency, context, or support.
contract.currentStateRule: OriginalBaseState, AlreadyAddedCompletionMembers, ProspectiveCandidate, ProspectiveCompletionSet, ProspectiveResultingState, and OriginalEvidenceIndex remain separate. Accepted synthetic heads describe current state only.
contract.candidateIdentity: lane + TapHead|LongNoteHead; releases and held tails are not completion members
contract.selectedRangeSemantics: The inclusive range filters opportunity source heads only. Evidence remains full-chart original-only and may come from outside the selected range.
contract.addChanceSemantics: The existing Bernoulli/chance path runs before D1 eligibility. D1 neither changes chance nor compensates for abstentions elsewhere.
contract.seedProtocol: No population seed claim is frozen. Future D1 must declare an explicit deterministic paired seed list before running; fixture seeds are implementation coverage only.

insertionPoint.semanticAnchor: after PlaceTap/PlaceLongNote returns a non-null TimedManiaObject and before added.Add/geometry.Insert
insertionPoint.beforeOperation: added.Add(placed.Object), geometry.Insert(placed), placement statistics, and output mutation
insertionPoint.afterOperation: chance roll, exact tap lane or LN shape/lane selection, and existing legal-geometry validation
insertionPoint.rngAlreadyConsumed: The chance roll and proposal-specific lane/shape RNG have already been consumed by legacy.
insertionPoint.diagnosticCaveat: Legacy diagnostics currently label the proposal Placed inside PlaceTap/PlaceLongNote; future D1 must record a separate direct disposition or revise that label atomically before mutation.

futureD1Outcomes: A: exact preregistration, deterministic and safe, nonzero admissions and abstentions across multiple families, attributable effects, noncollapsed output, exact rollback; continue technical evaluation/playtesting only
B: valid and interpretable but restricted, abstention-heavy, k3/downstream dominated, or one narrow research dependency remains; no promotion
C: degenerate, unsafe, unattributable, or unable to isolate joint evidence; rollback and park/redesign

canonicalization: UTF-8 System.Text.Json camelCase; no indentation for hash; record property order; all set-like arrays sorted ordinal; no timestamps or paths
